gaps: Exa returned402 credits exhausted on all four calls; no Exa results were available.
Web engines initially returned noisy namesakes and YouTube Help pages. Explicit DarrylAnka and exact playlist queries improved coverage; results are a curated discovery sample, not a census.
Many direct YouTube fetches returned only footer, throttled,429,or Google sorry; no alternate-route bot evasion was used. Such records retain search/embed-only access labels.

Simple Inspiration, SPIRITUAL WISDOM, Universe Meditations, Cosmic Bridge, Bashar Abraham1111, Universe Celebrations, Vibrational Mind, ReNew D Soul and Accera appear as publishers in retrieved sources, but exact account URLs were not securely exposed here. Do not fabricate handles from names.
Playlist titles and lengths can change; sample counts exposed by old crawls were not treated as current totals. Some exact published short list IDs remain unresolved.
All platform dates are upload metadata, not original channeling dates; none establishes a new human practitioner. AI/inspired/narrated content is explicitly flagged.
Japanese directory translations yielded useful new human/entity leads, but transliteration, full identity and current activity need primary-language followup.
summary: Two-stage broad discovery followed by exact-name/playlist enrichment. Captures Bashar distributors, exact playlists, individual watch/music links and multilingual source hubs, with metadata access and uncertainty retained.
